title: AI agents in 60 seconds
caption: AI agents in 60 seconds: a language model in a loop with tools, and why the loop is the whole trick.

scenes.say: A chatbot answers. An agent does things. The difference isn't a smarter model. It's a loop.

items.title: Think
items.say: The model decides what to do next.

items.title: Act
items.say: It calls a tool: search, run code, click a button.

items.title: Observe
items.say: It reads the result, and goes round again until the job is done.

scenes.say: The model never touches the world directly. It writes a request, and your code runs it.

scenes.text:
A model, a loop,
*and some tools.*
scenes.say: That's an agent. A model, a loop, and some tools.
